// REQ: LANG-2541 LANG-2542 LANG-2543 LANG-2544
// A point
struct Point { x : Double; y : Double } derive(Show)
fn Point::norm(self : Point) -> Double {
  (self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y).sqrt()
}
fn main {
  let p = { x: 3.0, y: 4.0 }
  let mut count = 0x1F
  match p.norm() { 5.0 => println("Hello, \{p}!") ; _ => () }
  count += 1
}
